push.body:

DID WELL
+ 2 key passes. You were the playmaker, the matchmaker and the good-time maker.
+ A goal against UK Chargers, your 5th straight match scoring. Right place, right time, right foot.
+ 2 shots on target: +0.1. Solid foundation stuff.
+ 1-0 against UK Chargers. A win's a win, and this was a good one.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
- 71% passing (17 of 24). Key note: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
- Rating came in 0.5 below what your on-ball stats earned. Next match: Hold the line with your partner and step up together. Don't let a dropping striker drag you out.
- forcing passes hit you and PhogsToffees both. Partner drill: give each other short options.
- 0.7 under your usual. Shake it off and lace 'em up.

Practice prescription: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.

One step at a time, partner. - Coach Lasso
